question: The value of 100 ÷ (10 + 12 - 2 × 6) is;
solution:
**Given Data:**

Expression: 100 ÷ (10 + 12 − 2 × 6)

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47485e25d1b30c57dc271863db8b99be0c8e209069b2596cc885911d898a8a78.png] 

**Solution:**

⇒ 100 ÷ (10 + 12 − 12) = 100 ÷ 10 = 100

**Therefore, the value of the expression is 10.**
